records.text: Andrew Guajardo accepted a chief medical examiner position in New York, and Ashley Guajardo took a full-time position at New York University.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Ashley Brown Guajardo and her husband have both—they've now gone to New York. He's accepted—now he's going to be the chief medical examiner in New York, and she's going to be teaching at NYU. We should pull up her LinkedIn, by the way.

verification.notes: Dutchess County confirms Andrew Guajardo accepted a New York position, but the official title is Medical Examiner, not chief medical examiner. NYU confirms Ashley Guajardo joined its faculty after leaving the University of Utah in 2025, while the located official profile does not itself label the appointment full-time. The relocation/employment core is supported, but the titles are overstated or incompletely supported.
